items.name: utils
items.description: Shared helpers used by components.

items.name: tokens
items.description: Design tokens as CSS variables (light and dark).

items.name: motion-css
items.description: Keyframes and reduced-motion rules for the optional motion components.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A stack of sections whose content expands and collapses under a heading, like an FAQ. Use with AccordionItem.

items.name: agent-activity
items.description: A short summary of what the assistant is doing or did, such as "Used 3 tools", that opens into each step. It stays open while a step needs approval.

items.name: alert
items.description: An inline message about the state of the page or a task: a tip, a success, a warning or an error. For brief confirmations that disappear, use Toast.

items.name: approval-box
items.description: Asks someone to approve or decline something the assistant wants to do. It says what will happen, how risky it is and whether it can be undone, in words as well as color.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A person's or account's picture, falling back to their initials when there is no image or it fails to load.

items.name: badge
items.description: A small label that states a status or category, like Paid, Overdue or Beta. Not interactive.

items.name: blur-fade
items.description: Content that sharpens and slides into place when it first appears or when it scrolls into view. It is visible to start with, so it never hides content from anyone.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.description: The path from the top of the site to the current page, as links. Use BreadcrumbItem for each step; the last one is the current page.

items.name: button
items.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Month grid for picking a date. RangeCalendar picks a start and end. Used inside DatePicker and DateRangePicker.

items.name: card
items.description: A bordered container that groups related content under an optional heading, with an optional footer for actions.

items.name: chart
items.description: A bar, line, area or donut chart drawn in plain SVG without a chart library. It fits its container, can be explored with a pointer or the arrow keys, and always comes with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers.

items.name: chat
items.description: A whole conversation with an assistant: the messages, a box to write in, and the stop and jump-to-latest controls. It shows what you give it and reports what the person does; it never calls a model.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Lets the user turn a single option on or off, with an optional indeterminate state.

items.name: citation
items.description: A small numbered marker, like [1], inside a reply that jumps to the source it refers to.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Text input that filters a list of options as you type. Supports multi-select tags, async loading and long, virtualized lists.

items.name: command-palette
items.description: A search box in a dialog that finds and runs commands, jumps to pages and triggers actions from the keyboard. Opens with Ctrl or Cmd + K. Use CommandGroup and CommandItem for the results.

items.name: customer-table
items.description: A ready-to-use customer list: search, filters, sorting, pages, CSV export, loading rows, an empty state, an error with retry, cards on a phone, and totals with a chart above that follow the filters. Give it customers and it works.

items.name: dashboard-page
items.description: One page of a dashboard: a title with its actions, a row of key numbers, then your content. It sits inside DashboardShell but works anywhere. The title is the page's h1.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.description: The frame of a dashboard or admin app: a sidebar of navigation that folds down to icons, a top bar with search and actions, an account menu, and the page. On a phone, or in any narrow space, the sidebar becomes a menu that slides in.

items.name: data-grid
items.description: A fast, accessible data grid for thousands of rows: sorting, filtering, grouping, editing, copy and paste, export and server-side data. Columns are TanStack Table column definitions.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Date field with a calendar popover. Typing and picking both work, in the user's locale.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.description: Start and end date fields with a two-month calendar and optional presets like 'Last 7 days'.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal window that asks for focus, such as a confirmation or a short form. Open it with DialogTrigger.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: What to show when a list, table or page has nothing in it yet: a short explanation and the next step.

items.name: file-upload
items.description: A drop zone and button for choosing files, with type, size and count limits and a list of the chosen files you can remove from. The component picks the files; you upload them.

items.name: generated-chart
items.description: A bar or line chart an assistant produced, drawn without a chart library, always with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers as a table.

items.name: generated-table
items.description: A table an assistant produced, shown as a real sortable table with a title and summary, numbers aligned, long results cut to a few rows, and a CSV download.

items.name: gradient-button
items.description: A button with a colour that travels around its edge. The label sits on the normal button surface, so its contrast is the plain Button's. Builds on Button.

items.name: gradient-text
items.description: Text filled with a gradient that keeps flowing, for a short headline or a highlighted word. The words stay real text.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, like Ctrl or ⌘K, in a keycap style. Not interactive.

items.name: menu
items.description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button, like a More (…) or Account menu. Use with MenuTrigger and MenuItem.

items.name: message
items.description: One message in a conversation, from you or the assistant. It renders each part in order with the right component: text as formatted markdown, tool calls as activity, tables and charts as real components, sources at the end.

items.name: number-field
items.description: A text field for numbers, with increment and decrement buttons, keyboard stepping, and locale-aware formatting for decimals, currency, units and percentages.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Page numbers with previous and next buttons, for content split across pages. Long ranges collapse to the first page, the last page, and the pages around the current one.

items.name: popover
items.description: Non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for extra controls or details. Open it with DialogTrigger.

items.name: progress
items.description: A bar showing how far along a task is, or that something is working when the amount is unknown.

items.name: prompt-input
items.description: The message box of a chat: one rounded bar with a + menu on the left, the text in the middle, and your own controls, a microphone and Send on the right. Added files show above the text. You get only the buttons you ask for.

items.name: pulse-button
items.description: A button with a soft ring that keeps radiating out, to draw the eye to the one action that matters now. Builds on Button.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Lets the user pick exactly one option from a small, visible set. Use with Radio children.

items.name: response
items.description: Shows an assistant's reply as formatted text: headings, lists, tables, code, links and source markers. It is safe for text you do not control and for text that is still arriving.

items.name: reveal-button
items.description: A button that opens an arrow beside its label when you hover or focus it, to suggest "go". Only a transition, so there is nothing to pause. Builds on Button.

items.name: ripple-button
items.description: A button that sends a ripple out from where you pressed it, or from its centre when pressed with the keyboard. Builds on Button.

items.name: ripple
items.description: Concentric rings that swell outward from the centre, as a calm backdrop behind a heading or a call to action. Content goes in front of the rings.

items.name: segmented-control
items.description: A row of connected buttons where exactly one option is chosen, for switching a view or a setting with two to five choices. Use SegmentedControlItem for each option.

items.name: select
items.description: Picks one option from a list shown in a popover. Use with SelectItem children.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, for filters, details or navigation on small screens. Open it with DialogTrigger.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.description: A button with a soft band of light that crosses its surface now and then, for one standout action. Builds on Button, so focus, disabled and loading work the same.

items.name: shine-border
items.description: A band of colour that slides steadily along a border, so the edge seems to catch the light. Wrap a card or a field.

items.name: shuttle-border
items.description: A point of light that runs around the edge of whatever is inside, like the shuttle of a loom crossing the threads. Wrap a card, an input or a button; give it your radius and background.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A grey placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives.

items.name: slider
items.description: Picks a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track. Shows the formatted value.

items.name: sources
items.description: The numbered list of sources a reply drew on, with title, site and a short excerpt. Each entry is where a Citation marker lands.

items.name: sparkline
items.description: A tiny line or bar graphic that shows the shape of a trend, without axes. Decoration unless it has a label.

items.name: stat
items.description: A key number with its label and context: a value, an optional change over time and an optional small trend graphic. Unframed: place it in a Card or a grid.

items.name: steps
items.description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step process, such as checkout or setup: done, current and upcoming steps. It displays progress; you control the steps and buttons.

items.name: switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, taking effect immediately.

items.name: table
items.description: A simple, accessible table for a small number of rows: optional sorting and row selection. Build it from TableHeader, TableColumn, TableBody, TableRow and TableCell. For thousands of rows, filtering, editing or grouping, use DataGrid.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Switches between related panels of content in the same place. Use with TabList, Tab and TabPanel.

items.name: tag-input
items.description: A text field that turns what you type into removable tags when you press Enter or comma: for keywords, recipients and labels.

items.name: text-field
items.description: Single-line or multi-line text input with a label, help text and error message.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.description: Text with a band of light sweeping across it, for a loading message or a quiet accent. The words stay real text: selectable and read as normal.

items.name: time-field
items.description: A field for a time of day, with separate hour, minute and (optional) second segments that follow the visitor's locale and 12 or 24 hour clock.

items.name: toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking message about the result of an action. Render ToastRegion once and call toast().

items.name: tool-call
items.description: One thing the assistant did, such as searching or running a query: its name, where it is (waiting, running, needs approval, done, failed), how long it took, and on request what went in and out.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Short text label shown on hover or keyboard focus. Wrap the trigger and tooltip in TooltipTrigger.

items.name: tree
items.description: An expandable hierarchy such as folders and files or a nested menu, with keyboard navigation and optional selection. Build it from nested TreeItem elements.
